description: Source code for the Affiliate controller in the Opencart admin marketing module. Handles affiliate management including listing, form submission, enabling/disabling, deletion, CSV export, report generation, and autocomplete.

classes.name: Affiliate
classes.description: Controller class for managing affiliates within the Opencart admin panel under marketing.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point for the affiliate management page, loads the affiliate list view with filters and links.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the list of affiliates, primarily for AJAX requests.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Fetches and renders the affiliate list with filtering, pagination, and actions.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form to add or edit an affiliate, including populating existing data.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes the form submission to create or update an affiliate record, with validation.

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Recalculates and updates the balance for all active affiliates.

methods.name: csv
methods.description: Exports selected affiliates' payout information as a CSV file.

methods.name: complete
methods.description: Marks selected affiliates' balances as paid and adds a transaction.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML view of the affiliate transactions report.

methods.name: autocomplete
methods.description: Provides an AJAX autocomplete for affiliate customer names and emails.
